name: ResupplyFi zero exchange-rate solvency bypass
summary: ResupplyPair inverted the collateral oracle price with integer division but accepted a zero result. After the attacker inflated an empty CurveLend vault's share price above 1e36, the calculated exchange rate rounded to zero and the pair's LTV calculation treated a 10 million reUSD loan against one wei of collateral as solvent.
notes: The vulnerable exchange-rate inversion and solvency logic are part of the pair's immutable direct runtime, activated when the new crvUSD-wstUSR market was deployed.
Resupply's post-mortem reports $10 million of reUSD bad debt, matching the exact 10,000,000 reUSD borrow executed in the anchored transaction.
The USD amount uses the protocol's reported face value of the reUSD bad debt.
